design_philosophy: Objective, rigid, and function-first. 95% of the UI is monochrome to prioritize data clarity (prices, stock, competitors). Color exists solely to guide action and indicate status (e.g., OOS, Price Drops, Sync Status). Sharp edges, dense spacing, and high-contrast typography.

layout.grid_system: The 'Control Room' Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized.
layout.spacing: Dense and compact. p-4 to p-6 for cards. Use generous spacing (p-8 to p-12) only for section boundaries.
layout.surfaces: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. border-collapse style layouts with 1px subtle borders (border-r border-b border-border). Subtle roundness (max 8px border-radius) or cardless sharp edges.
layout.alignment: Paragraphs, tables, and dense content left-aligned. Metrics center-aligned in summary widgets.

components.buttons: Flat solid background, 1px subtle border, sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-sm). ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. e.g. hover:bg-blue-700 hover:text-white
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables heavily customized for density. Sortable headers, sticky columns. No zebra striping, just 1px bottom borders. Hover states on rows with slight background tint.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow (shadow-sm).
components.navigation: Sticky left sidebar or compact top nav with Solid Background and hard bottom/right border.
components.charts: Shadcn chart components / Recharts. Minimal grid lines, monochrome bars with primary color highlight for current user/selected data.
components.forms: Shadcn components (Input, Select). Sharp edges, 1px border. Focus state: ring-1 ring-primary border-primary.

motion.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for interactive states.
motion.hover: Slight lift and border color darkening for cards. Background tint for table rows.
motion.micro_interactions: Smooth sorting indicators, loading spinners on sync buttons.

icons.style: Regular or Duotone for active states. Keep sizing consistent (w-4 h-4 for inline, w-6 h-6 for nav).

pages.name: Market Overview Dashboard
pages.description: High-level metrics (Total Competitors, Avg Price Changes, OOS Items). Use Control Room grid with summary metrics at the top.
pages.layout: Grid with 4 col-span-1 summary widgets. 2 large col-span-2 widgets for Charts (e.g., Price Trends).

pages.name: Competitor Management
pages.description: List of competitors (Zarafa, Petsy, etc.) and their sync status. Includes a form to Add/Edit/Remove competitors.
pages.layout: Simple list or grid of compact cards. 'Add Competitor' opens a Shadcn Dialog.

pages.name: Product Tracking Tables
pages.description: Dense data table displaying Product Name, Category, Price, Stock Status, Competitor. Features category filtering, price/stock sorting.
pages.layout: Full-width table with sticky header. Filter dropdowns above the table.

pages.name: Best Sellers Ranking
pages.description: Ranked list of best-selling products across competitors.
pages.layout: Numbered list or table with rank indicators (green/red arrows for rank changes).

pages.name: Price Comparison
pages.description: Side-by-side comparison of specific products across the tracked stores.
pages.layout: Matrix table: Products as rows, Competitors as columns. Cell contains Price and difference %.

empty_state_image.description: Minimalist 3D illustration of a cat and dog looking at data. Use for empty table states or 'No tracking data yet' screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure Shadcn UI components for Table, Button, Input, Select, Dialog, Card, Badge.
Implement real-time visual status indicators (e.g., green dot for 'Synced', red dot for 'Sync Failed').
Keep border radius strictly at max 8px (rounded-sm/rounded-md) or 0px for a sharp, data-first look.
Table headers must be sticky, and sorting arrows must be clearly visible.
Avoid large empty spaces inside data cards; pack data tightly but legibly using IBM Plex Sans.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='competitor-add-btn').
Do NOT use generic 'Inter' font. Import and apply Work Sans for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text in tailwind config.
Use the generated empty state image when a table has no data or when the user first logs in before adding competitors.
